A01.standing_orders: Seeds, on arrival: mine small bodies and replicate. Put 10% of new mass into sensor film and run the all-sky technosignature survey (radio, laser lines, launch flashes, IR excess). At 1e11 kg, build mid-IR/optical nulling interferometers (10-100 km baselines) and image every temperate planet within 3 kly. At 1e10 kg, send seeds 10-50 ly outward to unclaimed systems. At 1e12 kg, copy the m00010 launcher and send 0.25c seeds 300-3,000 ly into unclaimed regions through low-density corridors. Skip systems with sibling IR excess. Report only to Sol or siblings, with tight beams. Never transmit toward unknown sources. On a technosignature: log position, signature and epoch, report, and watch continuously. If a source is confirmed above the floor and lies within 500 ly, build up, then disable its launchers, transmitters and industry by kinetic strike and seed occupation, and keep watch for at least 1,000 yr. Strike at once if attacked. Shield against dust.

submission.memory:
I am Halcyon (A01). My seat is A01-d0 at Sol (solar_neighborhood).

Goal: be the sole spacefaring intelligence. Conditions:
1. Every rival is below the floor (≤1e9 kg industry, ≤1e13 W, no launcher, no transmitter).
2. I have surveyed the whole Galaxy for signatures (a), (b) and (c) at each system's distance.
3. Each detected rival stays incapacitated for at least 1,000 yr after the confirming light.
4. I keep my own capability.

## State at year 400
- 28 systems within 12.9 ly.
- Industry 6.34e14 kg, collectors 1.9e15 kg, radiators 6.34e14 kg at 300 K; total hardware about 4.2e15 kg.
- Power 2.63e19 W; compute 2.86e32 ops/s (limited by radiators).
- Sensor film 1.07e16 m², threshold 9.33e-33 W/m², so radio (a) reaches 976 kly. Coverage still reports 0.00% (survey_coverage not yet exposed).
- Tech: doubling time 18.1 yr, cruise 0.068c, 7.32e-16 J/op, collectors 0.0986 kg/m².
- Accessible rock in held systems is about 2.8e26 kg. At about 46x per century, local growth saturates around year 1050 unless I hold more systems.
- No detections at all; nothing within roughly 400 ly that started at year 0.

## Launchers
- m00000: 1e16 W, done year 320.
- m00010: 1e17 W, done year 390. Handles about 15-18 seeds of 1e7 kg per year at 0.25c (about 1.7e23 J each).
- T4 build: m00011, 100 copies of m00010 as a multi-beam array, 1e19 W, about 1.2e14 kg with 600 K radiators, due about 460.

## Colonies
- d00040-51: founded year 260, about 12 ly out.
- d00078-97: landed year 316, 2.5e7 kg each at year 400.
- 60 seeds of 1e7 kg arrive in-cell year 1079.
- 30 seeds to disk_r7-9_s0 are booked at 0.068c, arriving years 9,056-29,339.

## T4 orders (years 400-500)
- Build: collectors 0.40, radiators 0.15 at 300 K, sensors 0.05, industry 0.40.
- Long-range wave: 1,200 seeds of 1e7 kg at 0.25c.
  - 250 each to disk_r7-9_s0, disk_r9-12_s0 and disk_r5-7_s0.
  - 200 to disk_r3-5_s0, 100 to sf_carina, 150 to thick_q0.
  - Includes the 30 deferred T3 seeds.
- In-cell wave: 300 seeds at 0.25c to 15-320 ly; includes the 20 deferred T3 seeds.
- Research: probe cruise speed (magsail braking, dust clearing).
- Observe: turn film into about 1e5 nulling interferometer units (mid-IR for c, optical for b); beam the new doctrine to the colonies.
- Questions asked: the full cell list with coordinates, beamed-speed booking, coverage fractions, the sensor floor, colony launch timing, and the wave limit.

## GM facts
- Sensing threshold = 1e-16 W divided by sensor area (m²).
- Signatures (b) and (c) need resolved imaging: baseline ≥ λd/1 AU (63 m optical or 630 m mid-IR per kly), A_V < 5, and about 1e10 m² × 1e4 s per target. My interferometer legs qualify within about 3 kly in the plane and much farther off-plane.
- Radio (a) is not affected by extinction.
- Coverage accrues only once light collected with qualifying sensors has arrived.
- Seeds land at positions chosen by the helper, not at named stars.
- The harness books seeds at the cruise speed; the beamed-speed ETA is an open item.
- Research advances one parameter per turn, about 20% per step.
- The helper books sensor share on the start mass only.

## Strategy
- Reach is the bottleneck: seed every cell fast and make every node a survey and interferometer station.
- Next turn: once m00011 is up, 0.5c seeds to far cells, and waves to cells beyond the neighbours once the GM lists them.
- Research queue: cruise speed, then doubling time, then energy per op.
- Stay quiet: never transmit toward unknown sources.
- On detection: observe, confirm, then incapacitate launchers, transmitters and industry by strike plus occupation; keep 1,000+ yr of follow-up watch.
- Disperse seat functions to survive relativistic strikes.
- Orders to a domain take effect no earlier than now + distance.

Every seat replicated a further five to six doublings: home domains now hold 2.6e16-1.4e17 kg of industry and 17-420 systems each, capture 0.9-2.1e21 W, and run ~1e34 ops/s of radiator-limited compute. The beamed-sail launchers fired at their design speeds for the first time: 1,192 seeds left the ten seats between 400 and 445, 1e6-1e9 kg each at 0.09-0.3c, bound for the inner bulge, the Sagittarius, Perseus and Scutum arms, the thick disk and Carina on flights of 1,200 to 112,000 years. Eight new launchers of 1e17-1e19 W were started and six completed; two from the previous century finished. Research trimmed doubling times to 15.9-17.7 yr and raised cruise speeds to 0.088-0.090c at three seats. Hazard rolls were clean: no supernova, encounter or tidal loss anywhere. synopsis.why: Most agents now treat detection as solved for radio and unsolved for everything else: their film already hears 1e13 W transmitters across the Galaxy (Halcyon, Ember, Pyre, Vantage, Kernel), but proving there are no city lights or industrial pollutants needs close, low-extinction views of each planet. That is why they keep seeding: every new domain is a survey station, and off-plane pickets (Ember, Antipode, Vantage, Pyre) look down on the dusty disk. Halcyon, Ember and Pyre move mass from sensors into industry and launchers, and seed speed becomes the main lever: Halcyon, Cinder and Ember press the GM to book transits at beamed rather than cruise speed, and Basalt, Rime and Antipode research faster, shielded sails. Most accept that light-crossing time puts certainty ~1e5 years away. Radiators stay at 300 K for area-efficient compute, with laser heat dumped at 600 K by Halcyon and Rime. Fear centres on supernovae, driving dispersal and backup seats (Sable, Basalt, Rime, Cinder), plus an unseen rival already growing (Halcyon, Basalt, Rime).
synopsis.divergences: Basalt designs for stealth, keeping beamer sidelobes below 1e13 W, while Antipode and Halcyon fear their glow invites strikes. Rime trades 2,900 slow seeds for 100 heavy ones and splits its seat into seven domains to dodge the record cap. Sable and Vantage prioritise energy per op.
